name: iediagcmd.exe
author: manasmbellani

commands.command: set windir=c:\test& cd "C:\Program Files\Internet Explorer\" & iediagcmd.exe /out:{PATH_ABSOLUTE:.cab}
commands.description: Executes binary that is pre-planted at C:\test\system32\netsh.exe.
commands.usecase: Spawn a pre-planted executable from iediagcmd.exe.

detection: Execution of process iediagcmd.exe with /out could be suspicious
